name: Pack of 6 – CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Facial Kit | Deep Moisture & Skin Repair Skincare Set
description:
The CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Facial Kit (Pack of 6) is a complete skincare solution enriched with ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and niacinamide. Each step works together to deeply cleanse, exfoliate, hydrate, and repair your skin barrier for a smooth, radiant, and healthy-looking complexion. Designed for all skin types, this dermatologically tested kit provides salon-like results at home with long-lasting hydration and visible glow.
Key Features
 6-in-1 complete facial care routine
 Infused with ceramides, hyaluronic acid & niacinamide
 Deeply cleanses, exfoliates & hydrates skin
 Brightens complexion & reduces dullness
 Improves elasticity & smoothness with every use
 Suitable for all skin types, safe & dermatologist-approved
Ingredients / Materials
Essential ceramides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, mineral-rich hydrating formula
How to Use
 Step 1: Cleanser – Apply on damp face, massage gently & rinse
 Step 2: Scrub – Exfoliate in circular motions for 1–2 mins, rinse
 Step 3: Massage Cream – Massage face & neck upward for 5–7 mins, wipe excess
 Step 4: Mask – Apply evenly, leave 10–15 mins, rinse when dry
 Step 5: Skin Polish – Massage for 2–3 mins & rinse off
 Step 6: Face Wash – Final cleanse for fresh, hydrated skin
Package Includes
 6 × 100ml CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Facial Tubes (Complete Facial Kit)
